mentions.name: spynation
mentions.description: An open dataset mapping the structural connections between Israel's tech/startup ecosystem and its military-intelligence apparatus, documenting the pipeline from intelligence units to billion-dollar companies. It includes examples such as Wiz's founders coming from Unit 8200, SoftBank's Israel operations being run by a former Mossad director, and the $1.5B VC fund CyberStarts openly recruiting Unit 8200 graduates.
mentions.problem: The Israeli tech industry is presented as not a neutral commercial sector but a deliberate pipeline from military-intelligence units to billion-dollar companies, and these connections are not systematically mapped.
